question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**behind**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The passage begins with a well-known quote. The blank is part of this quote.
 
• The quote is from Percy Bysshe Shelley's "Ode to the West Wind," and the original line is "If Winter comes, can Spring be far behind?"
 
• The word needed to complete the quote correctly
